reason: A web GUI widget for monitoring DeepSeek API balance, daily and monthly usage, session costs, and pricing periods through periodic refreshes and visual status indicators.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示 API 余额、日月用量、会话费用和峰谷时段信息的可拖动配额监控组件。
summaries.en: A draggable quota-monitoring widget for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that displays API balance, daily and monthly usage, session costs, and pricing periods.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek API credentials and an optional platform token from configured credential storage
Queries DeepSeek balance and usage endpoints
Reads and persists quota snapshots and session cost data
Displays an auto-refreshing, draggable, collapsible quota widget in the web GUI
